about: The motion vocabulary of MotionStudio. The brief UI shows these as pickable chips, reference uploads are tagged with the categories, and the agent is told exactly which kit piece each id means. Add an entry here when you add something to src/studio/kit.

categories.title: Scene transitions
categories.hint: how one scene hands over to the next

categories.title: Camera & depth
categories.hint: movement of the virtual camera and layers

categories.title: Layouts
categories.hint: how a scene is composed on the canvas

categories.title: Accents & polish
categories.hint: details that make it feel premium

categories.title: Pacing & rhythm
categories.hint: how the cuts and beats feel

items.name: Soft fade
items.desc: Gentle crossfade with a tiny scale

items.name: Slide
items.desc: Next scene slides in sideways

items.name: Push
items.desc: New scene pushes the old one off screen

items.name: Wipe
items.desc: New scene is revealed over the old

items.name: Zoom through
items.desc: Old scene scales away, new one scales in

items.name: Blur dissolve
items.desc: Defocus out, focus in

items.name: 3D flip
items.desc: Scene turns like a card

items.name: Cube turn
items.desc: Quarter turn around the shared edge

items.name: Iris circle
items.desc: New scene opens as a growing circle

items.name: Split open
items.desc: New scene opens from the middle outwards

items.name: Shutter blinds
items.desc: Horizontal blinds open to the next scene

items.name: Glitch cut
items.desc: RGB split and jitter, techy and energetic

items.name: Mask reveal
items.desc: Lines rise out of an invisible mask (clean, editorial)

items.name: Word by word
items.desc: Each word pops up in turn

items.name: Springy letters
items.desc: Letters bounce in one by one (playful)

items.name: Blur into focus
items.desc: Words come out of a blur (cinematic)

items.name: Scramble decode
items.desc: Random glyphs resolve into the text (techy)

items.name: Typewriter
items.desc: Typed out with a blinking caret

items.name: Soft rise
items.desc: The whole block floats up and sharpens

items.name: Kinetic captions
items.desc: Captions that follow the voice word by word

items.name: Slow push-in
items.desc: Subtle zoom-in through each scene

items.name: Guided glide
items.desc: Camera glides to the part being explained

items.name: Parallax layers
items.desc: Foreground and background drift at different speeds

items.name: Spotlight focus
items.desc: Dim everything except what is being explained

items.name: 3D hero objects
items.desc: Real 3D phone, coin, bubble or card floating in space

items.name: Split screen
items.desc: Two panels side by side (text and visual, before and after)

items.name: Bento grid
items.desc: Mixed-size tiles that pop in one after another

items.name: Card stack
items.desc: Fanned cards that cycle one by one (features, testimonials)

items.name: Scrolling band
items.desc: Endless sideways band of logos or keywords

items.name: Hero centre
items.desc: One big subject centred with a short headline (compose with SpringIn)

items.name: UI walk-through
items.desc: Screenshot or app frame with cursor, toggles, counters

items.name: Light sweep
items.desc: A shine glides across cards and titles

items.name: Floating particles
items.desc: Sparkles and shapes drifting behind the content

items.name: Springy entrances
items.desc: Everything overshoots and settles

items.name: Counting numbers
items.desc: Stats count up with progress bars

items.name: Fast cuts
items.desc: Scenes 1.5 to 2.5 s, hard rhythm, a new visual every beat

items.name: Calm & smooth
items.desc: Longer holds, slow moves, room to breathe

items.name: Beat-synced
items.desc: Cuts and hits land on the voice or music beats

items.name: Slow build to a reveal
items.desc: Quiet start, tension, then one big payoff moment
